usage: Reference for HQ legislative development; outcomes must not appear in game dialogue or newspaper before their historical dates. Null denotes unverified or not researched, not absence. Public-law source links include enacted text; for non-enacted bills, recorded-vote or veto sources are provided; original bill text still requires review where null.

records.name: Economic Growth and Tax Relief Reconciliation Act of 2001

policyObjectives.ko: 2001년 경제성장 및 감세조정법이 서명됐다. 소득세 부담을 줄이는 것이 주요 목표다.
policyObjectives.en: The Economic Growth and Tax Relief Reconciliation Act became law, aiming to reduce income-tax burdens.

stages.description: McCain tax amendment fails on tie
Snowe child tax credit amendment adopted

records.name: Authorization for Use of Military Force

policyObjectives.ko: 9·11 테러 책임 세력을 상대로 군사력을 사용할 권한을 대통령에게 부여하는 결의가 법률이 됐다.
policyObjectives.en: A resolution authorizing the president to use military force against those responsible for the September 11 attacks became law.

records.name: USA PATRIOT Act of 2001

policyObjectives.ko: 테러 방지와 수사를 위한 연방정부의 법적 권한을 강화하는 법률이 제정됐다.
policyObjectives.en: Legislation expanding federal legal authority to investigate and prevent terrorism became law.

records.name: Aviation and Transportation Security Act

policyObjectives.ko: 항공 보안을 강화하기 위한 연방 법률이 제정됐다.
policyObjectives.en: A federal law to strengthen aviation security was enacted.

records.name: No Child Left Behind Act of 2001

policyObjectives.ko: 교육 성취 격차를 줄이고 학교의 책무성을 강화하는 연방 교육법이 제정됐다.
policyObjectives.en: A federal education law seeking to narrow achievement gaps and strengthen school accountability was enacted.

stages.description: No Child Left Behind becomes law
Senate approves education reform conference report

records.name: Bipartisan Campaign Reform Act of 2002

policyObjectives.ko: 1971년 연방선거운동법을 개정하는 초당적 선거자금 개혁법이 제정됐다.
policyObjectives.en: The Bipartisan Campaign Reform Act became law, amending the Federal Election Campaign Act of 1971.

records.name: Authorization for Use of Military Force Against Iraq Resolution of 2002
supporters: Todd Tiahrt (R), Darrell Issa (R), expressed support in debate

policyObjectives.ko: 이라크에 대한 미국의 군사력 사용을 승인하는 의회 결의가 법률이 됐다.
policyObjectives.en: A congressional resolution authorizing U.S. military force against Iraq became law.

records.supportArguments: Supporters argued Iraq posed a security threat and that diplomacy and inspections had not resolved the danger; these are contemporary claims, not verified findings about weapons.
records.opposeArguments: Opponents urged renewed UN weapons inspections and multilateral diplomacy before military authorization and objected to preemptive unilateral war.

records.name: Help America Vote Act of 2002

policyObjectives.ko: 투표 장비 현대화를 지원하고 연방선거 관리의 최소 기준을 마련하는 법률이 제정됐다.
policyObjectives.en: A new law supports voting equipment upgrades and sets minimum standards for federal election administration.

records.name: Homeland Security Act of 2002

policyObjectives.ko: 국토안보부 창설을 위한 법률이 제정됐다.
policyObjectives.en: Legislation establishing the Department of Homeland Security became law.

records.name: United States Leadership Against HIV/AIDS, Tuberculosis, and Malaria Act of 2003

policyObjectives.ko: HIV/AIDS, 결핵, 말라리아에 대응하는 해외 원조 법률이 제정됐다.
policyObjectives.en: A law authorizing foreign assistance against HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis and malaria was enacted.

records.name: Jobs and Growth Tax Relief Reconciliation Act of 2003

policyObjectives.ko: 일자리 및 경제성장을 촉진한다는 목표의 추가 감세법이 서명됐다.
policyObjectives.en: An additional tax-relief law aimed at jobs and economic growth was signed.

stages.description: Jobs and growth tax bill enacted

records.name: Medicare Prescription Drug, Improvement, and Modernization Act of 2003

policyObjectives.ko: 메디케어에 처방약 급여를 도입하는 개혁법이 제정됐다.
policyObjectives.en: Medicare reform establishing a prescription-drug benefit became law.

stages.description: Senate approves Medicare reform conference report

records.name: Intelligence Reform and Terrorism Prevention Act of 2004

policyObjectives.ko: 미국 정보기관 체계와 정보활동을 개편하는 연방 법률이 제정됐다.
policyObjectives.en: A federal law reorganizing U.S. intelligence institutions and activities was enacted.

records.name: Housing and Economic Recovery Act of 2008

policyObjectives.ko: 주택시장 위기에 대응하기 위한 연방 주택개혁법이 제정됐다.
policyObjectives.en: Federal housing reform legislation was enacted in response to housing-market distress.

stages.description: Housing and Economic Recovery Act enacted

records.name: Emergency Economic Stabilization Act of 2008

policyObjectives.ko: 금융시스템 안정을 위해 연방정부의 부실자산 매입 및 보증 권한을 마련하는 법률이 제정됐다.
policyObjectives.en: A law authorizing federal purchases and guarantees of troubled assets to stabilize the financial system was enacted.

records.name: Lilly Ledbetter Fair Pay Act of 2009

policyObjectives.ko: 차별적 임금 지급이 반복될 때마다 차별행위가 발생한 것으로 보는 법률이 제정됐다.
policyObjectives.en: A new law treats each paycheck reflecting unlawful pay discrimination as a discriminatory act.

stages.description: Lilly Ledbetter Fair Pay Act enacted

records.name: Children's Health Insurance Program Reauthorization Act of 2009

policyObjectives.ko: 아동건강보험 프로그램을 연장하고 개선하는 법률이 제정됐다.
policyObjectives.en: A law extending and improving the Children's Health Insurance Program was enacted.

records.name: American Recovery and Reinvestment Act of 2009

policyObjectives.ko: 일자리, 기반시설, 실업 지원과 주·지방정부 재정 안정에 연방 재정을 투입하는 경기부양법이 제정됐다.
policyObjectives.en: A stimulus law funds jobs, infrastructure, unemployment assistance and state and local fiscal stabilization.

records.name: Family Smoking Prevention and Tobacco Control Act

policyObjectives.ko: 식품의약국에 담배제품 규제 권한을 부여하는 법률이 제정됐다.
policyObjectives.en: A law granting the Food and Drug Administration authority to regulate tobacco products was enacted.

records.name: Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act
supporters: Barack Obama (D), Nancy Pelosi (D); House vote: 219 Democrats in favor
opponents: House Republicans and 34 House Democrats voted against; Jo Bonner (R) stated objections

policyObjectives.ko: 오바마 대통령이 건강보험 접근성 확대를 목표로 하는 환자보호 및 부담적정보험법에 서명했다.
policyObjectives.en: President Obama signed the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act, aimed at expanding access to health coverage.

records.supportArguments: Obama argued that reform would widen access and protect patients against abusive insurance practices.
records.opposeArguments: Bonner argued the coverage mandate would expand federal power and that Medicaid requirements, taxes and Medicare changes would impose costs. These are his contemporary arguments, not independently established predictions.

stages.description: House agrees to Senate health reform bill
Senate invokes cloture on health reform

records.name: Health Care and Education Reconciliation Act of 2010

policyObjectives.ko: 건강보험 개혁에 대한 후속 조정과 교육정책을 담은 예산조정법이 제정됐다.
policyObjectives.en: A reconciliation law containing follow-up health reform and education measures was enacted.

stages.description: Health and education reconciliation law enacted
Senate proceeds to health reconciliation bill
Senate tables McCain state-specific provisions amendment
Senate tables medical device tax repeal amendment
Senate tables Vitter health repeal amendment
Senate tables Medicare Part A opt-out amendment

records.name: Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act

policyObjectives.ko: 금융시스템의 투명성과 안정성을 높이고 금융소비자를 보호하기 위한 개혁법이 제정됐다.
policyObjectives.en: A financial reform law seeking greater transparency, stability and consumer protection was enacted.

stages.description: Senate approves financial reform conference report

records.name: Fair Sentencing Act of 2010

policyObjectives.ko: 코카인 관련 연방 형량의 불균형을 줄이는 것을 목적으로 하는 법률이 제정됐다.
policyObjectives.en: A federal law aimed at reducing disparities in cocaine sentencing was enacted.

records.name: Don't Ask, Don't Tell Repeal Act of 2010

policyObjectives.ko: 성적 지향을 공개한 군인의 복무를 제한하는 정책의 폐지를 위한 법률이 서명됐다.
policyObjectives.en: A law providing for repeal of the policy restricting open service by gay and lesbian personnel was signed.

stages.description: Don't Ask, Don't Tell repeal enacted

records.name: Budget Control Act of 2011

policyObjectives.ko: 부채한도를 둘러싼 정치적 교착 속에 연방 예산통제법이 제정됐다.
policyObjectives.en: The Budget Control Act became law amid a political impasse over the debt ceiling.

stages.description: Senate agrees to Budget Control Act amendment

records.name: American Taxpayer Relief Act of 2012

policyObjectives.ko: 연초 세금 문제에 대응하는 미국 납세자 구제법이 법률이 됐다.
policyObjectives.en: The American Taxpayer Relief Act became law, addressing tax policy at the turn of the year.

records.name: Violence Against Women Reauthorization Act of 2013

policyObjectives.ko: 1994년 여성폭력방지법을 재승인하는 법률이 제정됐다.
policyObjectives.en: Legislation reauthorizing the Violence Against Women Act of 1994 was enacted.

records.name: Agricultural Act of 2014

policyObjectives.ko: 농무부의 농업 및 관련 사업을 개편하고 연장하는 법률이 제정됐다.
policyObjectives.en: A law renewing and reforming Department of Agriculture programs was enacted.

records.name: USA FREEDOM Act of 2015

policyObjectives.ko: 정보감시 권한을 개편하는 USA FREEDOM Act가 제정됐다.
policyObjectives.en: The USA FREEDOM Act reforming surveillance authorities became law.

records.name: Every Student Succeeds Act

policyObjectives.ko: 1965년 초중등교육법을 재승인하는 모든 학생 성공법이 제정됐다.
policyObjectives.en: The Every Student Succeeds Act reauthorizing the 1965 federal elementary and secondary education law was enacted.

records.name: 21st Century Cures Act

policyObjectives.ko: 신규 치료법의 발견과 개발, 환자에게 전달되는 과정을 촉진하기 위한 법률이 제정됐다.
policyObjectives.en: A law aimed at accelerating the discovery, development and delivery of medical treatments was enacted.

records.name: American Health Care Act of 2017
supporters: Senate Republican leadership backed the partial repeal amendment
opponents: Susan Collins (R), Lisa Murkowski (R), John McCain (R) voted against S.Amdt. 667

policyObjectives.ko: 상원은 H.R. 1628에 대한 매코널 수정안 제667호를 49대 51로 부결했다.
policyObjectives.en: The Senate rejected McConnell Amendment 667 to H.R. 1628, 49–51.

records.opposeArguments: Collins argued partial repeal would destabilize insurance markets and fail to reduce premiums. Murkowski argued repeal without a clear replacement would create uncertainty.

stages.description: Pence breaks tie to begin health bill debate
Schumer health bill referral motion fails

records.finalDisposition: House passed; Senate partial repeal amendment rejected; not enacted.

records.name: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act (commonly used name)

policyObjectives.ko: 2018회계연도 예산결의에 따른 연방 세제개편법이 서명됐다.
policyObjectives.en: Federal tax reform legislation under the fiscal year 2018 budget resolution was signed.

stages.description: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act enacted

records.name: Economic Growth, Regulatory Relief, and Consumer Protection Act

policyObjectives.ko: 금융 규제를 일부 완화하고 소비자 보호를 강화하는 것을 목표로 한 법률이 제정됐다.
policyObjectives.en: A law providing targeted financial regulatory relief and consumer protections was enacted.

stages.description: Senate passes financial regulatory relief bill

records.name: First Step Act of 2018

policyObjectives.ko: 연방 형사사법 및 교정제도를 개혁하는 First Step Act가 제정됐다.
policyObjectives.en: The First Step Act reforming federal criminal justice and corrections became law.

records.name: Impeaching Donald John Trump, President of the United States, for high crimes and misdemeanors
supporters: Article II: 228 Democrats and 1 independent voted yes
opponents: Article II: 195 Republicans and 3 Democrats voted no

policyObjectives.ko: 하원이 권력 남용과 의회 방해에 관한 탄핵소추 조항을 각각 가결했다.
policyObjectives.en: The House approved articles of impeachment for abuse of power and obstruction of Congress.

records.finalDisposition: House adopted two impeachment articles; Senate proceedings outside N06 period.

records.name: Stem Cell Research Enhancement Act of 2005

policyObjectives.ko: 부시 대통령이 연방 줄기세포 연구 지원을 확대하는 법안에 취임 후 첫 거부권을 행사했다.
policyObjectives.en: President Bush issued his first veto against legislation expanding federal support for stem cell research.

stages.description: Bush vetoes stem cell research bill

records.name: Secure Fence Act of 2006

policyObjectives.ko: 국경 보안시설 확대를 규정한 Secure Fence Act가 대통령 서명으로 법률이 됐다.
policyObjectives.en: The Secure Fence Act, providing for expanded border security infrastructure, was signed into law.

records.name: Emergency economic stabilization proposal (amendment to H.R. 3997)

policyObjectives.ko: 하원은 금융위기에 대응하는 긴급 구제안을 205대 228로 부결했다.
policyObjectives.en: The House rejected an emergency financial rescue proposal by 205 votes to 228.

records.finalDisposition: Emergency rescue proposal rejected September 29; later legislation used H.R. 1424.

Senate clears immigration bill procedural hurdle
Senate approves public health preparedness report

Tribal representation in border oversight approved

Senate agrees to bipartisan budget measure
